reference_protocol: Select an approved reference from floor-local evidence before computing quality. Missing confirmed reference height means floor-only; no ceiling grafting.
raw_input_requirement: Retain X_rms_deg and Eperp_deg=X_rms_deg/2, source points and mean-x geometry. This Q is conditional geometric quality, not a standalone certification of raw input.

metric_units.Sb: degrees; symmetric mean nearest spherical floor-boundary arc distance, not RMS
metric_units.D: degrees; floor-edge-length-weighted RMS residual to jointly optimized common orthogonal axes
metric_units.Hm: absolute perimeter-mean wall-height difference divided by reference perimeter-mean wall height
metric_units.Hc: centered local wall-height residual divided by reference perimeter-mean wall height, frozen correspondence/tie rule

candidate_roles.J_main_hill_tail12_g1_l025: Primary: adds a smooth unsaturated serious-direction tail without changing the mild-error Hill term; global/local height scale ratio is four.
candidate_roles.J_simple_power8_g1_l025: Alternative for lower formula complexity; light/moderate D gets less penalty, changing many more ordinary-record scores. Human data do not decide uniquely.
candidate_roles.J_local_joint_hinge10_w2_s8: Alternative for length-supported local direction; minimizes the combined loss over axes to avoid the old fixed-L2-axis discontinuity. Requires extra real comparison evidence before replacing the primary.

selection_limits: Not the spurious decimal minimizer of a single fitted objective.
Existing human cases are development evidence, all old blind judgements retain unknown confidence.
Response-policy boundaries are analyst choices instantiating the user's priority, not human good/problem/severe class cuts.
Neither D nor its tail catches all orthogonal corner omissions; floor-reference comparison remains necessary.
